There’s no "right" way to dress—it’s about what makes *you* feel powerful. 2. **Body Positivity**: High heels and dresses can be tools for self-expression, especially if they help you stand taller (literally and figuratively). The way you carry yourself matters just as much as what you wear. 3. **Experiment**: If you enjoy this look, try playing with textures, colors, or accessories to keep it fresh. Or, if you want to explore other styles, do that too—confidence grows when you feel comfortable in different spaces. 4. **Mindset Shift**: Sometimes, confidence is a choice. Even if you’re not feeling "it" in the moment, reminding yourself, *"I look amazing"* can help shift your energy. Over time, this can become second nature.
